places.name: Charminar
places.blurb: Iconic 16th-century mosque and monument symbolizing the heart of the old city.

places.name: Chowmahalla Palace
places.blurb: Opulent 18th-century palace complex that once served as the seat of the Nizams.

places.name: Salar Jung Museum
places.blurb: Houses one of the world's largest one-man collections of antiques and art artifacts.

places.name: Birla Mandir
places.blurb: Serene white marble temple perched on a hill offering panoramic views of the city.

places.name: Hussain Sagar Lake
places.blurb: Heart-shaped lake featuring a giant monolithic Buddha statue in the middle.

places.name: Golconda Fort
places.blurb: Magnificent medieval fortress renowned for its acoustic architecture and diamond history.

places.name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
places.blurb: Stunning mausoleums showcasing Persian and Indian architectural styles set in landscaped gardens.

places.name: Ramoji Film City
places.blurb: World's largest integrated film studio complex offering guided tours and entertainment.

places.name: Ananthagiri Hills
places.blurb: Lush forested hills offering trekking trails, coffee plantations, and temple visits.

places.name: Thousand Pillar Temple
places.blurb: Exquisite medieval Hindu temple celebrated for its rock-cut architecture and rich carvings.

places.name: Warangal Fort
places.blurb: Historic 13th-century Kakatiya dynasty ruins featuring intricate stone gateway arches.
